recipes.name: One-Bowl Chewy Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl, cream together the coconut oil and brown sugar using a fork.
Then add the milk, cocoa powder, maple syrup, vanilla, baking powder, baking soda, instant coffee, and salt. Mix well. The mixture might look a bit clumpy, and that's okay*.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Add the flour to the bowl and stir until just combined. Careful to not over-mix.
Then gently fold in the chopped chocolate.
Form little balls out of the dough and evenly distribute, about 2 inches (5 cm) apart, on a lined baking tray.
To decorate, add a few bits of chopped chocolate to the top of each cookie. Bake on the middle rack of the oven for 12 to 14 minutes.
Let cool on the tray for a bit before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Refined coconut oil is coconut oil that doesn't smell or taste like coconuts. If you prefer a distinct coconut taste, use unrefined coconut oil instead. The coconut oil needs to be solid for this recipe, and not melted. If the oil is soft, place it in the fridge until hardened. † We use 50 - 60% cocoa chocolate for a balanced sweetness. Darker varieties (70%+) can make the result too bitter. * If the temperature is warm where you are, consider chilling this mixture in the fridge for 30 minutes to firm up, otherwise, the cookies may spread too much when baking.
Storage Store in an airtight container on the counter for up to 5 days or in the freezer for up to 1 month.
